convoLines.text: "About whatever's been weighing on me — I'm not okay. I'm saying it out loud so it's real: I'm not okay."
They settle in like someone glad you're here.
"Thanks. ...Thanks for saying that."
"Nice. Sit. The fire's warm."
"I can breathe all the way down again. I couldn't, before you sat down."
"…Still on that hard time."
"Alright. But I'm not carrying your stuff."
"Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"
"A name. Okay." You say it out loud, trying the shape of it:
🤝 "The Company." It hangs in the air a moment — then Hunter grins. It's real now. It has a name, which means it can be lost.
They go very still. Not relaxed-still. Held-still.
"I — I don't remember saying that." A beat. "People hear what they want to hear."
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
"I should go. You know where to find me."
"Thanks for... you know. Just listening."
"This was good." They mean it.
"Maybe it's only me — What do you make of all this? Really."
"Bleak. Probably true. I keep looking for the part where it's not."
"I think we're an experiment someone forgot to label. And the unlabeled part is what scares me — it means nobody's coming to check the results."
"Still on what you make of all this."
"...Fine. This had better be worth it."
"Forget I said anything. What did you want?"
"You want to know about that? Okay." "Jorge owed me a favor. I keep thinking about collecting. Stupid."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."

"Sleep's gone strange. I braid grass while listening to plans at odd hours now. Whatever gets me to morning."
"Well." A breath. "That's where things stand."
You show them Jewelweed — where it grows, how to tell it apart. They nod slowly, committing it to memory. "Good to know. Really good to know."
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"Do you dream about before? Or is it all — this — now?"
"Then it's not gone. Not really. Keep going back."

"Still on what you dream about."

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
